inventory_summary: Inventoried 38 metal-wall windows with K6 cap + 58114XX head + custom sill/jamb (cladding_trim/openings.py), 2 garage windows (head/sill trim, no cap), 36 doors (5 exterior with DOOR_HEAD_CUSTOM or catalog head envelope, D-B-SUNKEN/D-S-BALCONY catalog), 14 rough openings (2 ERV hoods with small-opening trim; AO-BW-MDO-TIE-RELIEF the only entry-screen opening, interior-blind), WIN-B-SAUNA (no flashing by design, spec s8). Dimensions from opening_flashing.py/opening_head_cap.py, library/trim/metal_sales.py, notes/opening_flashing_spec.md, french_door_catalog_installation.md; measured on the resolved model (pickle in scratch O5/). Opened all 15 sheets: A-002, A-201..204, A-512/.1/.2, A-513/.1/.2, A-514, A-515, A-525, A-526. Web: SureSill HeadFlash page (no section published), Metal Sales BBD75 install guide 10/2025 (58720XX p.28). Five prior ids reconciled; 5 new findings (1 model-only, 1 wrong-build, 2 drawing-error, 1 doc). NOT examined: the 3D viewer's K6 rendering (ui), IFC/GLB parity, A-511/A-503 and other detail sheets outside the listed set, rainscreen_closures net-free-area numbers (E2), BBD75 58720XX needed-over-frame arithmetic (0.38in vs 0.27in) re-derived (taken from round-1 note), D-B-SUNKEN court head/veneer reveal (spec s8 hand spec only), window_returns/stool (O4).

PANEL_END_STRIP sits at z 71.355..71.387 (head_drop 0.645in below the RO head); 58114XX seat 70.985..71.355. Panel is modelled 0.613in above the strip it is specified to sit on; 0.95in on the 9 Andersen units (WIN-M-BED-S1: RO head 80.0, strip 79.05). D-M-ENTRY: PANEL_END_STRIP z 86.403 vs cladding header z 82.875 = 3.53in (DOOR_HEAD_CUSTOM z 84.775..88.459 front 8.044in passes through the modelled panel, whose face is 6.75in). Sill side: cladding sill band z1 = 36.000 = RO sill while WINDOW_SILL_CUSTOM drip leg runs z 35.474..35.96 at the panel face plane (depth 7.25), 0.53in overlap. A-512.1 prints the dark cladding block ending at the RO head, 5/8in above the trim seat.

Same garage wall's D-G-SERVICE pan runs to depth 1.854in (0.98in past the panel).
evidence.expected: notes/opening_flashing_spec.md s7: 'The pan runs out past the panel to a drip' on a wall with no WRB and no cavity (CDX is the water plane). Outlet at clad + 0.5in like the doors, or the spec amended.
evidence.method: _pan_outlet returns frame.mount for any window whose seat has outer_m (metal_window), meant for the outie house walls where mount is 6in out; on the innie garage wall mount is the sheathing face. Re-run probe p10.py for WIN-G-N1 (flashing-sill depth range).

findings.proposed_fix: Gate the outlet-at-mount rule on frame.outie (not on metal_window) so garage windows use _drip_face; re-derive their seat sill_rise (window_seat uses the same outlet); 2 windows.
